Benda lives in the wilds of the Abujh Maad area of central India. His village
consists of three huts deep in the wilds. Wearing a small loin cloth and

practices a primitive form of agriculture called shifting cultivation. Benda

Benda chews on succulent leaves and roots. The boys have been trying to

tribal fair coming up the next full moon.

(A) Spatial Organization
(B) Areal Differentiation
(C) Regional Analysis
(D) Exploration and Description

4. Late 1950s to Late 1960s: Spatial Organization (Quantitative Revolution) (A).

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
